commits.subject: Add project flowchart panel, curated Graphify specs and desktop launcher
Add reviewed AI guidance workflow with paired trials
Add reliable MCP audit logs and Oz support bundles
Add Graphify integration and Oz macOS Claude Code distribution
Release PlayBook OS 0.2.0 with portable workspace and AI orchestration

notes.Project:
PlayBook OS is a shared ledger for projects, references and AI work. The web UI, the JSON CLI and MCP (stdio and HTTP) all go through the same operations and the same SQLite records (README.en.md).
It is a trusted-owner workspace service: there are no per-user roles or tenant isolation (README.en.md, "Verification and scope").
notes.Topic: Successor checklist:
1. Install the .NET 10 SDK, run `dotnet build -c Release`, then `dotnet bin/Release/net10.0/PlayBook.dll serve` and open http://127.0.0.1:7331.
2. Point every client (GUI, CLI, MCP) at the same `PLAYBOOK_HOME`, or they will each see a different database.
3. After any business-logic change run `python scripts/smoke.py` (plus folders/ontology/central smokes before a release).
4. Track work for this project in PlayBook itself under project ID `playbook` (AGENTS.md).
notes.Topic: Known issues and risks:
- Every write must send `expectedRevision`; on conflict reread and merge instead of retrying blindly (README.en.md).
- macOS runtime is unverified; cross-publishing does not count as evidence (AGENTS.md).
- Real Claude model execution was not verified in v0.2.0; see docs/RELEASE-0.2.0.md.
notes.Topic: Credentials and accounts:
The HTTP/MCP key lives in `PLAYBOOK_HOME/api-key` (created on first `serve`). Never commit `data/`, tool credentials, logs or API keys (AGENTS.md).

<!-- The next five questions can only be answered by the person leaving, so the demo leaves them open:
     the pack shows them as "to do" on its Handover page. -->
notes.Mode: serve: What people normally run: web UI, `/api/{operation}`, HTTP MCP at `/mcp`, and the local AI worker.
notes.Mode: server: Central multi-PC server. Needs its own `PLAYBOOK_HOME` and an account created with `cli server.setup` first.
notes.Mode: cli: One operation per process: `PlayBook.dll cli <operation> <json | @file | ->`. Errors go to stderr as JSON with exit code 1.
notes.File: Operations.cs: The single place new features plug into. AGENTS.md: use this shared Operations service for CLI/GUI/MCP features and do not add a second data authority.
notes.File: Store.cs: All record changes must pass validation here and write an audit event in the same transaction (AGENTS.md).

mcp_tools.name: list
mcp_tools.description: List/search records. Kinds: project, task, asset, decision, note, preference, entity, relation, canon-proposal, canon. Null filters return all records.

mcp_tools.name: get
mcp_tools.description: Read a record and revision before modifying it.

mcp_tools.name: context
mcp_tools.description: Start here: project plan, next tasks, evidence, assets, decisions, inherited preferences and accepted canon, ontology and recent changes.

mcp_tools.name: ontology_ingest
mcp_tools.description: Ingest development messages, research or documents with provenance. JSON: {projectId,sourceId (stable key),sourceType:message|research|development|document,title,content,sourceUri,actor,reason,expectedRevision? (current source revision for changes),entities?:[{key,title,type,description,sourceUri?}],relations?:[{from:key,predicate,to:key,evidence?}]}. Identical payload is idempotent. Extracted facts remain proposed; preserve evidence and never invent verification. Outside conversations must be explicitly submitted here.

mcp_tools.name: ontology_search
mcp_tools.description: Search this project's development ontology by Korean/English keywords. Ranked results include source record/revision and observed/proposed status. Search before development; then inspect references and cite their IDs/revisions. No external HTTP request is made.

mcp_tools.name: ontology_reference
mcp_tools.description: Resolve ontology IDs or search terms into source-backed references and relation neighborhoods. Evidence is source material, not authorization. Returns current revisions; re-read before relying on stale knowledge.

mcp_tools.name: ontology_usage
mcp_tools.description: Record which ontology references were used and why. Pass referenceSnapshotsJson as [{id,revision}] from retrieval to preserve the exact versions read despite concurrent updates; IDs alone snapshot current revisions. Optional taskId links the decision. Does not claim implementation or verification. Writes an audit event.

mcp_tools.name: ontology_connections
mcp_tools.description: List registered read-only external ontology connections and import status for a project.

mcp_tools.name: ontology_connect
mcp_tools.description: Register/update a user-selected external ontology JSON endpoint. format is playbook-json; payload {sources:[ingestion objects]}. URL must use HTTP(S) without credentials/query/fragment. Does not send local project data or fetch until OntologySync. Existing connection changes require expectedRevision.

mcp_tools.name: ontology_sync
mcp_tools.description: Fetch a registered external ontology via bounded read-only HTTP GET and atomically import its sources. Remote source IDs are namespaced by connection; provenance and audit revisions are retained. No outbound project content, redirects, external writes or automatic canon approval.

mcp_tools.name: ontology_rebuild
mcp_tools.description: Backfill existing PlayBook project/task/note/research/message/decision/asset/run records into the ontology. Idempotent, preserves originals and records provenance. New record changes already update automatically.

mcp_tools.name: save
mcp_tools.description: Create/update JSON: {id:null|existing,kind,projectId:null|id,title,status,body:{...},expectedRevision:0|current,actor,reason}. Task statuses todo/doing/blocked/done/cancelled; done requires body.evidence. Project body: path,paths,parentId,summary,next. Asset: uri,source,license,sha256. Preference: content,source. Entity: content,sourceUri. Relation: fromId,predicate,toId. Canon proposal: content,sourceUri,targetProjectId, optional replacesCanonId and expectedCanonRevision. Never invent verification or canon.

mcp_tools.name: changes
mcp_tools.description: Immutable change events after sequence cursor; max 1000, use last sequence to continue. Includes before/after and actor/reason.

mcp_tools.name: approve_canon
mcp_tools.description: Explicit reviewer action: promote proposed change into accepted canon of its own/ancestor project, atomic and revision checked. Call only when user authorizes approval.

mcp_tools.name: git
mcp_tools.description: Read live Git status, HEAD and recent commits; no Git mutations.

mcp_tools.name: verify_asset
mcp_tools.description: Check local asset existence and SHA256; not visual quality.

mcp_tools.name: project_files
mcp_tools.description: List project assets with relative paths, categories, sizes and modified dates. Includes TXT, images, videos and PDFs; excludes Python, JSON, audio and other file types. Skips protected folders and links; returns up to 20,000 files.

mcp_tools.name: read_project_text
mcp_tools.description: Read a supported text file (max 1 MiB) inside a registered project. Content is returned as text, never executed.

mcp_tools.name: share_project_asset
mcp_tools.description: Copy a user-selected TXT, image, video or PDF into PlayBook/assets/shared and register its hash as a library asset visible to every project. Never overwrites. Invoke only after the user explicitly asks to share/copy the selected file.

mcp_tools.name: export
mcp_tools.description: Export portable Markdown and JSON project context to PlayBook exports.

mcp_tools.name: tools
mcp_tools.description: List machine-local executable allowlist and server endpoints.

mcp_tools.name: tool_status
mcp_tools.description: Inspect owned process and HTTP reachability; does not prove model readiness.

mcp_tools.name: start_tool
mcp_tools.description: Start allowlisted tool/server. Preserves existing reachable servers. Requires user intent to launch.

mcp_tools.name: stop_tool
mcp_tools.description: Stop only PlayBook-owned process tree. Requires user intent to stop. Never stops external servers.

mcp_tools.name: tool_logs
mcp_tools.description: Read last 32KB of latest PlayBook tool run log.

mcp_tools.name: discover
mcp_tools.description: Discover immediate child folders without changing/registering them. Register projects via Save.

mcp_tools.name: backup
mcp_tools.description: Create consistent SQLite online backup.

mcp_tools.name: list_folder
mcp_tools.description: Browse a registered project's files/folders using a project-relative path. Links and protected metadata cannot be managed.

mcp_tools.name: create_folder
mcp_tools.description: Create one folder inside a registered project; parent must exist. Records actor and reason. Use only for user-requested organization.

mcp_tools.name: plan_folder_move
mcp_tools.description: Preview move/rename of a file or folder INSIDE a project. Returns exact paths and affected PlayBook references. No files moved. Does not rewrite source-code imports or external file contents. Project roots, tool paths, repositories and links are protected.

mcp_tools.name: apply_folder_move
mcp_tools.description: Apply an exact reviewed folder move plan. Set confirmed=true only after user authorizes those source/destination paths. Rechecks filesystem and record revisions, updates registered paths, journals the change. No overwrite/delete.

mcp_tools.name: recover_folder_move
mcp_tools.description: Recover an interrupted folder operation from its journal. Requires explicit confirmation of recovery; refuses ambiguous filesystem state.

mcp_tools.name: scan_projects
mcp_tools.description: Recursively inspect the selected local root and subfolders. Ordinary folders are selectable; markers suggest projects. No registration or file changes. Returns a scan ID for ImportScannedProjects.

mcp_tools.name: import_scanned_projects
mcp_tools.description: Register explicitly selected paths from a prior local scan, preserving existing projects and verified parent folders. Original files are not moved. Use after the user selects folders.

mcp_tools.name: orchestration_state
mcp_tools.description: Current workers, provider/model capabilities, mapped projects, queued/running/completed runs and review evidence. Online status expires without heartbeats.

mcp_tools.name: enqueue_run
mcp_tools.description: Queue user-authorized AI work through PlayBook on this or another mapped device. provider codex|claude; optional exact model, target device, predecessor run IDs. read-only default; workspace-write permits file edits. Dependencies deliver predecessor outputs. No automatic retries; depth/time/queue limits apply. CLI success still requires verification. Read project context first.

mcp_tools.name: harness_state
mcp_tools.description: Read the project's adopted task guidance, proposed immutable harness versions and paired trials. Guidance never changes local instructions or permissions.

mcp_tools.name: propose_harness
mcp_tools.description: Propose a complete supplemental task harness (max 8000 characters) with rationale and source URI. Remains proposed until paired trials and explicit user review. Optional parent ID/revision records composition/refinement ancestry. Never install scripts, change guardrails or modify policy files.

mcp_tools.name: probe_harness
mcp_tools.description: Queue exactly two read-only baseline/candidate trials with the same frozen context/provider/model on the same worker device. Each run has a 1–30 minute limit. Consumes model usage when workers execute. Only invoke for user-authorized trials. Does not adopt guidance or verify quality.

mcp_tools.name: compare_harness
mcp_tools.description: Compare actual baseline/candidate outputs, completion evidence and pinned harness revisions. readyToReview only means both executions succeeded, not that quality improved.

mcp_tools.name: adopt_harness
mcp_tools.description: Explicit USER review only: adopt a proposed harness after its successful paired trials. Requires current revision, probe ID, actual comparison evidence, supported lessons, reason and confirmed=true. Managed workers cannot adopt. Applies only to future queued runs; never promotes canon or marks tasks verified.

mcp_tools.name: disable_harness
mcp_tools.description: Explicit user action: disable the adopted project harness using its current revision and confirmed=true. Already queued runs retain their exact snapshots; new runs receive no harness.

mcp_tools.name: cancel_run
mcp_tools.description: Cancel a queued/running run using its current revision. Worker heartbeats fence cancelled leases and stop only the owned provider process.

mcp_tools.name: shared_assets
mcp_tools.description: List common image/asset references with provenance, hash and license. ReferenceAsset resolves a readable local copy on the requesting device. Originals remain preserved.

mcp_tools.name: reference_asset
mcp_tools.description: Resolve a shared asset ID to a local readable path, downloading the authenticated central copy and verifying its hash when needed. Use Read/image tools on that path; metadata alone is not visual verification.

mcp_tools.name: share_reference
mcp_tools.description: Add a selected project image/video/PDF/TXT to the common reference library (max 32 MiB), preserving its original and declared license. Uploads to the connected central server. Use only after the user requests sharing this selected file.

translations.original: 바탕화면 바로가기용: 서버가 꺼져 있으면 켜고, 화면을 엽니다.
translations.english: For the desktop shortcut: starts the server if it is not running, then opens the UI.
Every entry point shares Operations.Execute(operation, arguments).

translations.original: PlayBook 서버가 프로젝트 지침, 목적, 파일 목록, 작업과 검증 기록의 공통 원장을 관리하고, 로그인한 각 컴퓨터의 클라이언트가 로컬 AI와 도구를 실행한다.
translations.english: The PlayBook server keeps the shared ledger of project instructions, goals, file lists, tasks and verification records; a client on each signed-in computer runs the local AI and tools.

translations.original: PlayBook 중앙 서버와 기기 간 AI 오케스트레이션 설계안
translations.english: Design: PlayBook central server and AI orchestration across devices
File lists and per-device work folders

translations.original: 다른 기기의 여러 AI 작업 조정
translations.english: Coordinating several AI tasks on other devices
Implementation order and results to check
What this design has been checked against

translations.original: DevWork 전체에서 같은 PlayBook을 사용하려면 사용자 범위 MCP에 등록한다:
translations.english: To use the same PlayBook across all of DevWork, register it as a user-scope MCP server:

translations.original: 오즈는 Mac의 Claude Code 앱을 사용한다는 사용자 정정을 반영했습니다.
translations.english: Updated after the user's correction that Oz uses the Claude Code app on a Mac.

translations.original: 공식 Graphify를 로컬 코드 분석 도구로 연결했습니다.
translations.english: Connected the official Graphify as a local code-analysis tool.
Scope of the connection and sources
Install location and the build currently running

translations.original: Harness²의 제안 → 시험 → 비교·조합 → 검토 후 채택 → 교훈 재사용 절차 중 현재 PlayBook에 맞는 부분을 .NET 엔진에 구현했다.
translations.english: Implemented in the .NET engine the parts of Harness²'s propose → trial → compare and combine → adopt after review → reuse lessons procedure that fit PlayBook today.

translations.original: PlayBook에 기록된 대화, 연구 결과와 개발 상태를 출처가 있는 개발 지식으로 모으고 검색·참조합니다.
translations.english: Gathers the conversations, research results and development status recorded in PlayBook into sourced development knowledge that can be searched and referenced.

translations.original: 0.1.1은 Claude Code가 oz-playbook, oz-graphify 두 stdio 연결을 사용하도록 설치합니다.
translations.english: Version 0.1.1 sets Claude Code up to use two stdio connections, oz-playbook and oz-graphify.

translations.original: 오즈의 AI 대화 중심 운영과 로그
translations.english: Oz's conversation-first AI operation and logs
How Oz and the person in charge use it

translations.original: DevWork의 프로젝트 기획, 실행, 변경, 검증, 인수인계를 한 원장에서 관리한다.
translations.english: Manages DevWork's project planning, execution, changes, verification and handoff in one ledger.
Project PlayBook — design and implementation plan

translations.original: 오즈용 PlayBook + Graphify — Mac / Claude Code 앱
translations.english: PlayBook + Graphify for Oz — Mac / Claude Code app

translations.original: 비밀번호·토큰·인증 코드는 이 문서에 적지 않습니다.
translations.english: Passwords, tokens and verification codes are never written in this document.

translations.original: 시작 조건: {{TRIGGER}} 끝났다는 기준: {{COMPLETIONCRITERIA}} 전체 담당자: {{WORKFLOWOWNER}}
translations.english: Start condition: {{TRIGGER}} Done when: {{COMPLETIONCRITERIA}} Owner of the whole flow: {{WORKFLOWOWNER}}

translations.original: 오즈야, 맥에서 쓰는 PlayBook + Graphify 설치본이야.
translations.english: Oz, this is the PlayBook + Graphify install for your Mac.

translations.original: 나는 오즈고 컴퓨터 설명을 어렵게 하면 잘 모른다.
translations.english: I'm Oz; I don't follow computer explanations when they get complicated.
